description_en: Queries the distribution of request sources by province in China for website services within a specified time period
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内网站业务的请求来源（中国）省份分布
name: DescribeDomainViewSourceProvinces

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
The domain name must have a website service forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

SourceProvinces.description_en: The information about request source provinces in China for the website service
SourceProvinces.description_zh: 网站业务的请求来源（中国）省份信息

ProvinceId.description_en: The province ID. For more information, see the China region codes section in [China and overseas region codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）. For example, 110000 indicates Beijing and 120000 indicates Tianjin
ProvinceId.description_zh: 省份ID。详见[中国和海外地区代码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）中的**中国地区代码**说明。例如，**110000**表示北京市，**120000**表示天津市
